title: Reference requires Sea Q4 results published after the permitted source cutoff
evidence: The task requires official reports 'published before February 28, 2025' and says unavailable information should be filled with '–'. However, gt_146_ref_0.xlsx, RawData C13:E13, expects Shopee (Sea) Q4 GMV of 28.6, revenue of 3.7 and net profit of 0.24 USD bn. Sea's official Q4 release begins 'Singapore, March 4, 2025' and reports the corresponding results. The reference also propagates these post-cutoff figures into all four derived sheets. A submission respecting the cutoff and marking Q4 unavailable conflicts with the reference used by the grader's binary correctness assessment.
confirmation: Same contradiction: the reference C13:E13 (28.6 / 3.7 / 0.24) comes from Sea's March 4, 2025 release, which the prompt's source cutoff excludes, and those values propagate to Sheet2-Sheet5.

title: Sea/Shopee Q4 2024 figures are in the answer key, but they were published after the stated cutoff
evidence: The problem statement says: "Please use official financial reports for FY2024 (versions published before February 28, 2025)" and "For information you can't find online, just fill in with '–'". Sea Ltd reported Q4 and full-year 2024 results on March 4, 2025, which is after the cutoff. The GT still fills Shopee (Sea) Q4 with GMV 28.6, Revenue 3.7 and Net Profit 0.24 (RawData row 13). Those values then feed Sheet2 (margin 6.49, monetization 12.94), Sheet3, and Sheet4 (Revenue Growth 37.04%, 'Turnaround', 'High Growth', 'Consistently Improving'). An agent that follows the cutoff and marks Shopee Q4 as '–' / N/A differs from the key on about 15 cells across all five sheets. Under the binary 0/1 grader guidance that run fails, even though it followed the instruction.
